prior_status: The granularity deficit was proved and conditional entropy was paid only under a hard finite fiber-support cap.
new_status: Conditional entropy is paid by a soft Renyi-half fiber complexity. The resulting restricted FEI class includes genuine Boolean fibers with unbounded Fourier support and has an exact tensor exclusion law. Full FEI remains open.
mathematical_delta: Replaced log support by averaged conditional Renyi-half entropy, proved exact tensor additivity, and exhibited x times AND_k with support 2^k but effective support below 9.
remaining_obstacle: No universal influence or granularity-deficit payment for A_{1/2} is proved; fixed-Renyi point defects obstruct naive universal bounds.
next_action: Seek a Boolean-stable inequality paying A_{1/2} by influence plus Gamma_d on a growing class, tested first on rare point defects and shared signed dictators.
